name: Protokol Mitseliy: Prolog
source:
Grigore believed in Kudesh's order, the will of the Great Mycelium, and faithfully served as Mortimarch Sorge's personal assistant.
Then he became a Rejected.

Mycelium Protocol: Prologue is a linear visual novel blending cyberpunk and biopunk. Live through several pivotal days in Grigore's life, discover everyday life in the Upper City and the process of symbiotic grafting, take part in the mysterious Club's debates, and watch the world he knows slowly begin to fall apart.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5167940/]Steam[/url]]
